description:
Title: Find a Job

You have to regularly report, to which companies you wrote job applications.
Based on your job applications, new potential job offers are sent to you.
Companies have to confirm that they received job applications and rate the application.
A job interview can be negotiated.
When a company wants you to work for them, you enter the probation phase.
After probation phase, you can rate the company and the company can rate you.
Reviews for a company can only be seen (by job applicants) after 1 year.
If a job becomes permanent, the process ends, unless you rated the company C or less, then you continue to receive job offers, but no longer have to report.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/find-a-job">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ApplicationConfirmation" name="Application receipt confirmation and rating"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PotentialJobOffer" name="Potential job offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CompanyWantsApplicant" name="Company wants applicant to work for them"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CompanyRating" name="Company rating of applicant"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_FindAJob" name="Find a Job" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_FindAJob" name="Start"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReportApplications" name="Regularly report companies applied to"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ApplicationConfirmation" name="Receive application confirmation and rating">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ApplicationConfirmation" messageRef="Message_ApplicationConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_PotentialOffer" name="Receive potential job offer">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_PotentialOffer" messageRef="Message_PotentialJobOffer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewDecision" name="Negotiate a job interview?" default="Flow_SkipInterview"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateInterview" name="Negotiate a job interview"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewMerge" name="Continue after interview decision"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CompanyWantsApplicant" name="Company wants you to work for them">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CompanyWantsApplicant" messageRef="Message_CompanyWantsApplicant"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Probation" name="Enter probation phase"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RateCompanyDecision" name="Rate the company?" default="Flow_SkipApplicantRating"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateCompany" name="Rate the company"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RatingReviewSplit" name="Continue after rating"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_WaitOneYear" name="Wait one year">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_OneYear">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P1Y</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeReviewVisible" name="Make company review visible to job applicants"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ReviewVisible" name="Company review visible to job applicants"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RatingReviewMerge" name="Continue after rating choice"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CompanyRatesDecision" name="Company rates you?" default="Flow_SkipCompanyRating"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CompanyRating" name="Receive company rating">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CompanyRating" messageRef="Message_CompanyRating"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CompanyRatingMerge" name="Continue after company rating choice"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_JobBecomesPermanent" name="Job becomes permanent">
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_JobPermanent">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">job becomes permanent</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RatingThreshold" name="Rated the company C or less?" default="Flow_RatingAboveC"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Process" name="Process ends"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ContinueOffers" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RatingThreshold" targetRef="Event_PotentialOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">rated company C or less</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ContinueOffers" name="Continue receiving job offers without reporting"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Report" sourceRef="StartEvent_FindAJob" targetRef="Task_ReportApplications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Report_Confirmation" sourceRef="Task_ReportApplications" targetRef="Event_ApplicationConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirmation_Offer" sourceRef="Event_ApplicationConfirmation" targetRef="Event_PotentialOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Offer_InterviewDecision" sourceRef="Event_PotentialOffer" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NegotiateInterview" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewDecision" targetRef="Task_NegotiateInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">interview is negotiated</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SkipInterview" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewDecision" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewDone" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewMerge_CompanyWants" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge" targetRef="Event_CompanyWantsApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyWants_Probation" sourceRef="Event_CompanyWantsApplicant" targetRef="Task_Probation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Probation_RatingDecision" sourceRef="Task_Probation" targetRef="Gateway_RateCompanyDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RateCompany" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RateCompanyDecision" targetRef="Task_RateCompany">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">you rate the company</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SkipApplicantRating" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RateCompanyDecision" targetRef="Gateway_RatingReviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rating_ReviewSplit" sourceRef="Task_RateCompany" targetRef="Gateway_RatingReviewSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RatingSplit_WaitYear" sourceRef="Gateway_RatingReviewSplit" targetRef="Event_WaitOneYear"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitYear_ReviewVisible" sourceRef="Event_WaitOneYear" targetRef="Task_MakeReviewVisible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewVisible_End" sourceRef="Task_MakeReviewVisible" targetRef="EndEvent_ReviewVisible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RatingSplit_Continue" sourceRef="Gateway_RatingReviewSplit" targetRef="Gateway_RatingReviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RatingReviewMerge_CompanyDecision" sourceRef="Gateway_RatingReviewMerge" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyRatesDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyRates" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyRatesDecision" targetRef="Event_CompanyRating">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">company rates you</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SkipCompanyRating" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyRatesDecision" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyRatingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyRatingReceived" sourceRef="Event_CompanyRating" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyRatingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyRatingMerge_Permanent" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyRatingMerge" targetRef="Event_JobBecomesPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Permanent_RatingThreshold" sourceRef="Event_JobBecomesPermanent" targetRef="Gateway_RatingThreshold"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RatingAboveC" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RatingThreshold" targetRef="EndEvent_Process"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FindAJob">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Job applicant" processRef="Process_FindAJob"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Companies" name="Companies"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ApplicationConfirmation" name="Application receipt confirmation and rating" sourceRef="Participant_Companies" targetRef="Event_ApplicationConfirmation" messageRef="Message_ApplicationConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PotentialOffer" name="Potential job offer" sourceRef="Participant_Companies" targetRef="Event_PotentialOffer" messageRef="Message_PotentialJobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CompanyWantsApplicant" name="Company wants applicant to work for them" sourceRef="Participant_Companies" targetRef="Event_CompanyWantsApplicant" messageRef="Message_CompanyWantsApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CompanyRating" name="Company rates applicant" sourceRef="Participant_Companies" targetRef="Event_CompanyRating" messageRef="Message_CompanyRating"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
